store.description: Lethal Company in the browser. Land on a moon, loot the facility and get back to the ship before dark — the quota doesn't care whether you make it.
features: Scrap runs on hostile moons with a quota to meet
First-person movement, scanning and proximity chat
WASD + mouse, E to interact, Q to scan
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
